feature: Simulation responds during construction
design_implication: Test the defining experience with incomplete as well as complete circuits.

feature: Adjust parameters while running
design_implication: Make value changes feel immediate and keep the result state clear.

feature: Animate current and encode voltage on the canvas
design_implication: Help users explain a circuit; retain numbers and an animation-off option.

feature: Show compact readings beside the circuit
design_implication: Test whether inline information reduces attention switching without clutter.

feature: Probe a node or component directly
design_implication: Make the first useful measurement easy to obtain.

feature: Move from a reading to a waveform
design_implication: Avoid making users configure a separate instrument for every signal.

feature: Exact values alongside exploratory controls
design_implication: Support both experimentation and reproduction.

feature: Pause, restart and inspect history
design_implication: Expose what continues and what resets after an edit.

feature: Virtual bench instruments
design_implication: Test whether familiar controls help or overwhelm new makers.

feature: Interactive switches and real inputs
design_implication: Enable experiments that resemble manipulating a physical circuit.

feature: Open and modify a working example
design_implication: Start from an understandable circuit with a specific question.

feature: Restore an example after experimenting
design_implication: Encourage exploration without fear of destroying the starting point.

feature: Use physical component/breadboard views
design_implication: Measure transfer to a real build and wiring speed, not visual appeal alone.

feature: Reusable subcircuits with visible I/O
design_implication: Let a known-working block become a simpler building unit.

feature: Guided experiments with questions and expected behavior
design_implication: Validate learning and independence; do not assume a lesson catalog is sufficient.

feature: Contextual explanation of a failing circuit
design_implication: Show the affected object, cause and a reversible next action.

feature: Visible move, rotate, duplicate and delete
design_implication: Test first-time discovery without requiring a tutorial.

feature: Fast, configurable keyboard commands
design_implication: Support repeated expert work without making shortcuts mandatory.

feature: Preserve intended connections while moving parts
design_implication: Measure unintended disconnections and control over rerouted wires.

feature: Clear selection, pan, zoom and properties
design_implication: Keep navigation and editing predictable across views.

feature: Granular undo and discoverable redo
design_implication: Recovery is part of experimentation, not just file management.

feature: Interactive routing that respects constraints
design_implication: Assist placement while preserving explicit control and reversible outcomes.

feature: Switch between assistance modes
design_implication: Make it clear when the tool will move surrounding objects.

feature: Find an actual usable device quickly
design_implication: Measure successful placement and simulation, not search-result volume.

feature: Present symbol, model, footprint and physical identity together
design_implication: Extend unified part concepts with explicit simulation readiness.

feature: Show model provenance, coverage and compatibility
design_implication: Reveal unsupported behavior before the user relies on a result.

feature: Guide importing a vendor model
design_implication: Provide pin mapping, validation and a small test circuit.

feature: Install and update libraries in the application
design_implication: Keep dependency management out of the first experiment.

feature: Keep project references stable when parts are renamed

feature: Preserve the project’s required library content
design_implication: Make reopening independent of later library removal or updates.

feature: Compare measurements and computed signals

feature: Sweeps, tolerances and stress checks

feature: Behavioral code blocks

feature: Explicit valid, stale, incomplete and failed states

feature: Saved reproducible experiments

feature: Run firmware with supported peripherals

feature: Debug code, serial traffic and digital signals
